description: IPC Directive and Daemon Protocol Audit Rules & Detection Logic for Conex Desktop Engine

unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.rootCause: Frontend ConnectionManager sends 'authenticate' on connection open, but Daemon protocol registry does not declare an 'authenticate' inbound type.
unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.recommendedFix: Add 'authenticate' to Daemon protocol registry or update ConnectionManager to rely on Daemon initial 'welcome' / 'daemon-ready' handshake.

unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.rootCause: Frontend clientApi and schedule.ts use dot-separated legacy names ('cron.list_tasks'), whereas Daemon defines 'list-workflows'.
Frontend clientApi uses 'cron.upsert_task', whereas Daemon expects 'create-workflow' or 'update-workflow'.
Frontend clientApi uses 'cron.delete_task', whereas Daemon expects 'delete-workflow'.
Frontend clientApi uses 'mcp.list_servers', whereas Daemon protocol defines 'list-mcp-servers'.
Frontend clientApi uses 'mcp.upsert_server', which is not implemented in Daemon.
unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.recommendedFix: Use 'start-mcp-server' or implement 'upsert-mcp-server' in Daemon protocol registry.

unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.rootCause: Frontend clientApi uses 'mcp.delete_server', whereas Daemon defines 'stop-mcp-server'.
unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.recommendedFix: Update clientApi.deleteMcpServer to send 'stop-mcp-server' or implement 'delete-mcp-server'.

unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.rootCause: Frontend providerAuth requests 'oauth-start', which has no handler registered in Daemon.
unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.recommendedFix: Fall back to local PKCE flow or register 'oauth-start' handler in Daemon config-handlers.

unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.rootCause: Frontend providerAuth requests 'oauth-refresh', which has no handler registered in Daemon.
unsupportedOrUnregisteredTypes.recommendedFix: Fall back to local token refresh or implement 'oauth-refresh' in Daemon.

detectionRules.name: Unregistered Inbound Message Type Detection
detectionRules.assertion: Captured message type MUST exist in DAEMON_INBOUND_MESSAGE_TYPES registry.
detectionRules.actionOnViolation: Flag as unsupported WS message type and raise CI warning/error.

detectionRules.name: Legacy Namespace Convention Warning
detectionRules.assertion: Frontend SHOULD NOT use dot-separated legacy RPC names when kebab-case equivalents exist in Daemon.
detectionRules.actionOnViolation: Migrate dot-separated message types to Daemon canonical kebab-case names.

missingCommands.rootCause: Frontend calls invokeCmd('open_url', { url }), but 'open_url' is not registered in main.rs generate_handler!.
missingCommands.recommendedFix: Use host_openers::workbench_open_host_target or register open_url command in main.rs.

callbackIdInvalidationPaths.name: HMR / Webview Reload During Long-Running Invoke
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.scenario: A long-running command (e.g. core_search_files or workbench_git_status) is invoked. The webview reloads before Rust finishes execution.
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.symptom: Console error: 'Callback ID xxx is not registered' or IPC response lost.
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.mitigation: Wrap invoke calls with tauriInvoke.ts helper to handle unexpected webview tear-down gracefully.

callbackIdInvalidationPaths.name: Sidecar Event Emission to Destroyed Webview Window
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.scenario: Sidecar process emits 'workbench-run-event' via AppHandle after the main window is closed or reloaded.
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.symptom: Event dispatch failure in Rust / dropped window events.
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.mitigation: Check window.is_visible() / window presence in Rust sidecar event router before emitting.

callbackIdInvalidationPaths.name: Unwrapped Direct Invoke Promise Rejection
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.scenario: Direct window.__TAURI__.invoke without try/catch wrapper encountering missing command or serialization error.
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.symptom: Unhandled promise rejection in window global scope.
callbackIdInvalidationPaths.mitigation: Enforce all frontend IPC calls to go through apps/crish-desktop/src/api/tauriInvoke.ts.

detectionRules.name: Unregistered Tauri Invoke Command Detection
detectionRules.assertion: Invoked command MUST exist in main.rs register_handlers! macro.
detectionRules.actionOnViolation: Flag as missing Tauri Rust command.

detectionRules.name: Safe Invoke Wrapper Enforcement
detectionRules.assertion: Frontend SHOULD use tauriInvoke.ts instead of importing raw invoke directly.
detectionRules.actionOnViolation: Warn developer to convert direct invoke calls to invokeResult/invokeCmd.
